name: Chloe
source: A young human, and one-time member of the Organisation. Before [spoiler]the MC used a full-powered SHATTER on her[/spoiler], she was a hardline anti-Fey fanatic, willing to do whatever it took to eliminate humanity's greatest threat. Now, however, it is hard to tell what, if anything, remains of her…
